name: Mother of Waters
source:
A visual novel where one woman’s quick meal spirals into unexpected consequences. Set in Rio de Janeiro, the story is steeped in Brazilian folklore.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=35408]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说，讲述了一个女人的快餐引发了意想不到的后果。这个故事以里约热内卢为背景，充满巴西民间传说。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=35408]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
